what-v2-dark.svg: One model, five roles: Five roles share one Claude Sonnet 4.6 model. Each role has its own system prompt and temperature. Moderator: Opens with a sharp focus question, then distils each round into agreement, disagreement and a sharper follow-up. Proposer and critic: The proposer argues for, the critic argues against. Both engage the other side directly. Both have research tools. ReAct per debater turn: Up to MAX_TOOL_CALLS = 4 calls to tavily_search / tavily_extract, then prose. Sources appear inline as [claim](https://url) links. Judge: Ends each round: continue, or emit a verdict. An optional max_rounds cap (default 3) is defence in depth. Output: The full transcript, a VERDICT: line, and both trace URLs. An excerpt is in docs/REFERENCE.md

privacy-v2-dark.svg: Tracing is on by default: LANGSMITH_TRACING=true in .env.example, plus the Langfuse callback in main.py (build_run_config()). Everything goes to both tracers: Every run sends the topic, all prompts, every model reply and the raw Tavily results, including full page text from tavily_extract, to LangSmith and Langfuse. Do not debate anything you would not paste into those dashboards. Run without LangSmith: Set LANGSMITH_TRACING=false. Indirect prompt injection: Scraped pages go back into the model as tool results, so a page can carry instructions aimed at the LLM. Acceptable for a local toy with read-only tools. Keep it in mind before giving the agent tools that act

how-v2-dark.svg: One StateGraph: One LangGraph StateGraph, six nodes, one conditional edge. The moderator is one function registered at two positions (moderator_open, moderator_distill); it branches on len(transcript) == 0. Termination lives in state: Not in a counter: verdict: str | None is the single source of truth. The judge parses its own output to set it. max_rounds is defence in depth. ReAct only in debater nodes: _run_with_tools() in debate/nodes.py. Moderator, judge and setup stay pure-LLM: they arbitrate structure, not evidence. Run names: Each LLM call carries a run_name like proposer-argument-r1. ReAct iterations add -iter0, -iter1, .... Design history: docs/superpowers/specs/ and docs/superpowers/plans/. Full reference: docs/REFERENCE.md

tools-v2-dark.svg: tavily_search: 4 results with title, url and a ~500-char snippet. Usually the first call of a turn. tavily_extract: The full page as clean markdown. For when a snippet is too thin for a proper quote. One place for the knobs: Both come from langchain-tavily (https://pypi.org/project/langchain-tavily/). Retrieval knobs live in debate/tools.py: max_results=4, search_depth="basic", include_answer=False. Clean close at the cap: The loop forces one clean close with the tools still bound and tool_choice={"type": "none"}. Anthropic rejects a history with tool_use blocks when no tools are defined. Tool errors do not crash the debate: They surface as ToolMessage(content="Tool error: ...") and stay visible in both tracers. The rate-limit day is not hidden

env-v2-dark.svg: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY TAVILY_API_KEY: The model and the search. LANGSMITH_TRACING LANGSMITH_API_KEY LANGSMITH_PROJECT LANGSMITH_ENDPOINT: LangSmith. EU accounts must set the EU endpoint; a wrong region means 403 on /runs/multipart uploads. LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY LANGFUSE_HOST: Langfuse. RATE_LIMIT_MAX_RETRIES RATE_LIMIT_MAX_SLEEP_SECONDS RATE_LIMIT_BASE_SLEEP_SECONDS: The 429 guardrail in debate/rate_limit.py. It honours the retry-after header, backs off exponentially otherwise, and stacks on the Anthropic SDK's own retries (default 2 per call): a long 429 storm costs up to 3 x (RATE_LIMIT_MAX_RETRIES + 1) requests

scope-v2-dark.svg: Iterations are cheap: Edit, run, inspect trace, repeat. Ten documented tweaks (prompts, termination rule, max_rounds, MAX_TOOL_CALLS, search_depth="advanced", model per role, a new role, tools for the judge) are listed in docs/REFERENCE.md. Validation is mostly manual, via traces: tests/ holds offline regression tests for the forced-close and judge-cap edge paths and the rate-limit guardrail. Not in scope: No persistence, no UI, no API (CLI only), no streaming, no tool caching, no cross-turn source dedup, no multi-user sessions. Tools for proposer and critic only (Approach 1): Approach 2, the judge as fact-checker with receipts, is mapped in the Tavily design spec, not wired in. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-04-21-tavily-tool-use-design.md. Fork freely
